Codex reads this file instead of `AGENTS.md`; full rules: `AGENTS.md` and

- Per commit: type-check + lint + tests covering the change; before push/PR, the
  full suite, all green. Never bypass git hooks.
- Complete work, no stubs; root causes, not workarounds; surgical, simple diffs.
- Ask before destructive git (`reset --hard`, `checkout -- .`, `clean -f`,

- No OS schedules (cron, systemd, launchd, schtasks): scheduling lives in the app.
- Small, local work directly; delegate independent parts, broad exploration or
  long work — for context and parallelism, not speed.
- Multi-session work: rulebook tasks (`rulebook_task` MCP or `rulebook task`).

# Project-Specific Overrides

Add your custom rules and team conventions here.
This file is never overwritten by `rulebook init` or `rulebook update`.

## Task ids (overrides the `phase<N>_<kebab-name>` example in `.rulebook/specs/rulebook.md`)

Task ids are `phase<N>.<M>_<kebab-name>`, where `<M>` is the dependency level inside phase `<N>` (1 + the highest level of its same-phase prerequisites); tasks with the same `<N>.<M>` can run in parallel; children come before their parent; the phase gate is the last level. Example: `phase0.1_approved-source-index`. Index: `docs/task-index.md`; rule source: `docs/dag.md` (Task decomposition rule).
<!-- OVERRIDE:END -->
